title: A System for Train Condition Monitoring and Structural Health Assessment of Rail Vehicles
description:
arXiv:2608.05221v1 Announce Type: new 
Abstract: The ongoing digitalization of rail systems and the increasing use of artificial intelligence (AI) are fundamentally transforming the design, operation, and maintenance of rail vehicles. While fully automated operation at Grade of Automation 4 (GoA4) is well established in metro systems, its deployment in mainline rail remains limited. This is primarily due to stringent safety requirements and the complexity of open operational environments. Curren
